items.prompt:
Biodiversity is
A) the variety of different species in an ecosystem
B) the weather
C) a single species' size
D) the temperature
items.answer: A) the variety of different species in an ecosystem

steps: Biodiversity is the variety of species.

items.prompt:
A forest with 40 species has ____ biodiversity than one with 12.
A) greater
B) less
C) the same
D) no

Which factor can lower biodiversity?
A) Pollution
B) Clean water
C) More habitat
D) Protection

A population is
A) the number of individuals of a species
B) the number of ecosystems
C) the weather
D) a type of rock
items.answer: A) the number of individuals of a species

steps: A population is the count of one species.

items.prompt:
A new predator drops a prey population from 200 to 50. The cause is
A) the new predator
B) clean water
C) more sunlight
D) nothing

steps: The introduced predator lowered the prey population.

items.prompt:
If a species count rises from 15 to 25 after a habitat is protected, biodiversity
A) increased
B) decreased
C) stayed the same
D) disappeared

Introducing a new species can change populations because it
A) can prey on or compete with existing species
B) never interacts
C) has no effect
D) makes more weather
items.answer: A) can prey on or compete with existing species

steps: A new species can raise or lower other populations.

items.prompt:
The best way to compare the biodiversity of two ecosystems using data is to
A) count the species in each and compare
B) guess
C) measure the temperature only
D) weigh them
items.answer: A) count the species in each and compare
